financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Private Placement of common stock and pre-funded warrants closed July 31, 2023; gross proceeds (net not given)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The gross proceeds of the Private Placement were approximately $25 million, before deducting offering expenses payable by the Company.

warrants.quote: Warrants to purchase 4,434 shares of the Company’s common stock at an exercise price of $140.25 per share which were previously issued by Tocagen, survived the Merger and remained outstanding as of June 30, 2023 and December 31, 2022.
The Pre-Funded Warrants have an exercise price of $0.001 per share of Common Stock, were immediately exercisable and remain exercisable until exercised in full.
